title: Woreda Facilitator
description: SNV is a global development partner, deeply rooted in the countries where we operate. We are driven by a vision of a better world: a world where across every society all people live with dignity and have equitable opportunities to thrive sustainably. To make this vision a reality, we need transformations in vital agri-food, energy, and water systems. SNV contributes by strengthening capacities and catalyzing partnerships in these sectors. We help strengthen institutions and effective governance, reduce gender inequalities and barriers to social inclusion, and enable adaptation and mitigation to the climate and biodiversity crises. Building on 60 years of experience, we support our partners with our technical and process expertise and methodological rigor. We do this in more than 20 countries in Africa and Asia with a team of approximately 1,600 colleagues. By being adaptable and tailoring our approaches to these different contexts, we can contribute to impact at scale, resulting in more equitable lives for all. Our core values of people-centeredness and respect, equity and equality, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental to who we are and what we do. This is reflected in our vision, mission, and strategy, which set out our aspirations and commitments as our compass towards 2030. For more information on our operations in Ethiopia and SNV, generally visit our website: www.snv.org Project background SNV Ethiopia is recruiting an experienced Woreda Facilitator for Realizing Aspiration of Youth in Ethiopia through Employment (RAYEE II) program in South Gonder: Wereta, covering Libo Kemkem and Fogera woredas. Realizing Aspiration of Youth in Ethiopia through Employment (RAYEE II) is a five-year (August 2025 to August 2030 inclusive) youth employment creation project which is being implemented in Collaboration with Mastercard Foundation. The program aims to secure 800,000 dignified and fulfilling job opportunities for rural young women. The program will embrace a market system approach in high-potential value chains, (horticulture, poultry, dairy and complementary value chains), grounded in seven regional clusters. title: Customer and Sales Engagement Specialist
description: Join TalentPop App as a Customer and Sales Engagement Specialist! At TalentPop App , we're building a team of talented remote professionals who are passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and driving business growth. As a Customer and Sales Engagement Specialist , you'll play a key role in engaging customers, identifying sales opportunities, recovering lost revenue, and building lasting relationships that contribute to the success of our growing organization. If you’re passionate about sales, thrive in e-commerce environments, and enjoy turning customer conversations into opportunities, this role is for you! IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED: APPLICATION FAST-TRACK! To ensure your application is reviewed by the **Recruitment Team**, you must follow these critical steps exactly. **Applications that do not choose 'Brand Concierge' and enter the correct code WILL NOT be reviewed.** When selecting the position during your application, please choose “Brand Concierge” from the list of available roles. Recover Sales: Handle subscription recovery, winbacks, and abandoned cart assistance to re-engage customers and boost retention. Order Management: Manage order-related concerns such as tracking, returns, and exchanges, ensuring a positive post-purchase experience that encourages repeat sales. Familiarity with Shopify, CRM tools, or customer engagement platforms is a plus. Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced remote environment. HMO health coverage or a monthly health stipend for your well-being. Performance and recognition bonuses for top achievers. 100% permanent work-from-home setup — skip the commute! A supportive, friendly team culture with real opportunities for growth. Ready to connect with customers, drive e-commerce sales, and deliver an exceptional online shopping experience? Apply now to become a Customer and Sales Engagement Specialist at TalentPop App!
